create_starlette_app: create a Starlette app with CORS, gzip, and Prometheus middleware for the webhook service
create_app_with_config: create a Starlette app from an AppConfig with MongoDB resources and webhook routes
run_webhook_server: run the webhook service as a uvicorn server on a configured host and port
review_create_app_with_config: review the create_app_with_config function to understand how storage clients and MongoDB resources are initialized
refactor_webhook_routes: refactor the webhook route configuration to add new endpoints or modify existing ones
